Lessons6 lessons
1. Introduction to CBT▾

Understand links among situations, thoughts, emotions, body sensations, and actions.

2. Thinking Traps▾

Identify common patterns such as catastrophizing, filtering, mind-reading, and all-or-nothing thinking.

3. Thought Records Part 1▾

Begin a structured record by identifying the situation, emotions, thoughts, and initial responses.

4. Thought Records Part 2▾

Challenge a hot thought with evidence and develop a more balanced alternative.

5. Understanding Worry▾

Distinguish worry from problem solving and notice beliefs that keep worry going.

6. Safety Behaviours & Exposure▾

Identify avoidance and safety behaviours that maintain anxiety.
